posts.name: Nithin
posts.cooked: can we use commands like info, –help, man during oppe?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Yes, you can use info, --help & man pages. But please refrain from using any external cheatsheets and terminals embedded AI or auto suggestions.
